messages:
Maria S.: Quick sync — prepping an audit bundle for SOC2/ISO. Need artifacts for: RBAC change history, KMS integration + rotation proof, vuln triage timeline, and incident response evidence. Auditor handoff is tomorrow. What absolutely must go in the package?

Josh (compliance): Start with the RBAC PRs + approvals (GitHub PR links), IAM change logs (cloud console audit logs), and the formal change control ticket IDs. For KMS: rotation events, KMS config export, and KMS audit log snippets showing API calls for key use/disable. Also include our control mapping spreadsheet (which control maps to each artifact).

Sam (infra): We can export access logs and IAM policy diffs. Note: any logs we hand off must be sanitized for customer PII. I can produce a redacted export and the script used to redact. Also we keep immutable copies in our cold S3 bucket (write-once object lock enabled) — include the object-lock proof.

auditor_jones: Thank you. For KMS rotations I need a cryptographic proof of rotation (timestamped event + key version fingerprint). Will accept cloud KMS key-version IDs + associated operation logs. Also please provide who triggered rotations and the approval trail. For RBAC I want a list of accounts that had privileges escalated in the last 12 months and the justification tickets.

infra-bot: Export job started by @Sam.

infra-bot: ```
job_id: export-1793000001
status: completed
output: s3://redwood-audits/exports/1793000001/audit_pack_1793000001.zip
sha256: 3b9f2a7d4f2b1a6c8e9d2b7c6a4f0c1e2d3b4a5c6d7e8f9a0b1c2d3e4f5a6b7c
notes: redaction: applied (PII patterns), object-lock: enabled
```

Maria S.: Nice — can you also include the control mapping to SOC2/ISO IDs? Auditor will want table that shows artifact -> control (e.g., RBAC PR -> CC6/ISO A.9). I can draft but need someone to review.

Josh (compliance): I'll review the mapping. High-level mapping we'll include: RBAC changes -> SOC2 CC6/CC7, ISO27001 A.9.2/A.9.4; KMS key lifecycle -> CC6/CC8, ISO A.8.2/A.10.1; Incident response timeline -> CC7/CC8, ISO A.16.

Sam (infra): For vuln triage evidence, I'll attach the triage spreadsheet, ticket IDs, patch dates, and the post-mortem links for the two incidents in the last 6 months. Also exporting EDR alerts and mitigation scripts. Example redaction command I used: ```bash
python tools/redact_logs.py --input /var/logs/cloud-activity.log --patterns email,ssn --output /tmp/cloud-activity-redacted.log
```

auditor_jones: Good. One more ask: retention and immutable storage proof. Please include the S3 bucket policy + object-lock headers for the archived copies and the retention policy docs (how long we keep logs and why). Also include who has the ability to change retention (IAM role names).

Maria S.: Sam — can you confirm retention periods for the different artefact types (auth logs, KMS logs, EDR) and drop links here? I can assemble into the bundle naming convention: redwood_audit_<yyyyMMDD>_pack.zip.

Sam (infra): Confirming: auth logs (CloudAudit) — 3 years immutable; KMS logs (KMS audit) — 3 years immutable; EDR/forensics snapshots — 7 years archived (per enterprise policy). Dropping links in the bundle.

Josh (compliance): Also add the chain-of-custody sign-off: who packaged the bundle, who validated redaction, and who approved release to auditor. We use the standard sign-off template (see repo: infra/audit/templates/chain_of_custody.md).

Maria S.: I'll be the release owner for this handoff. @Josh can you do the mapping review by EOD? @Sam please ensure the export includes the sha256 and object-lock evidence. Auditor, anything else before we ship? :slightly_smiling_face:

auditor_jones: That looks good for now. Once I review the bundle I'll ask follow-ups if anything is missing. Please ensure the triage tickets include timestamps and responsible engineer names. Thanks! :thumbsup:
